name: Should I consider higher baseboards for my home?

mainEntity.name: Should I consider higher baseboards for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Considering higher baseboards for your home can significantly impact the visual appeal and perceived scale of a room, especially in spaces with higher ceilings. Taller baseboards often create a more substantial and luxurious feel, drawing the eye and adding architectural interest. This is a design decision we discuss during the planning phase of your residential design-build project, helping you achieve a customized aesthetic that enhances the beauty and long-term value of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Higher baseboards can enhance room aesthetics and perceived scale, a design decision we discuss to achieve a luxurious feel for your home.
